theme.title: A Journey into the Underworld
theme.subtitle: Underworld Engine • Mobile Pub Game Platform

roles.name: Navigator
roles.description: Charts subterranean currents and celestial markers in the Stygian mist.

roles.name: Oracle
roles.description: Deciphers echoes, prophetic portents, and spectral whispers.

roles.name: Scholar
roles.description: Knows ancient ciphers, Greek tablets, and forbidden cartography.

roles.name: Torchbearer
roles.description: Wields the sacred eternal flame through the cavernous gloom.

roles.name: Negotiator
roles.description: Strikes pacts with shade sentinels and Charon's ferrymen.

rounds.title: Round 1: The Stygian Totem
rounds.subtitle: Align all phone screens side-by-side to assemble the severed mythic codeword.

rounds.title: Round 2: The Gates of Tartarus
rounds.subtitle: Each crew member holds an isolated fragment of the Stygian incantation. Speak aloud to combine your clues.

data.narrative: The iron gate demands a sacred beast's name. Each role holds a different constraint whispered across the river Styx.

roleClues.title: Astral Inscription
roleClues.clue: The word has 8 letters. The 1st letter is C, and the 5th letter is E.
roleClues.detail: Visible in the celestial cavern zenith.

roleClues.title: Spectral Riddle
roleClues.clue: A three-headed sentinel beast who guards the subterranean gates so no soul escapes.
roleClues.detail: Echoes from the depths of Erebus.

roleClues.title: Linguistic Cipher
roleClues.clue: Letter 2 is E, Letter 3 is R, and Letter 4 is B. (Spells C-E-R-B...)

roleClues.title: Flame Reflections
roleClues.clue: The 6th letter matches Letter 3 ('R'). The 7th letter is 'U'.

roleClues.title: Ferryman's Clause
roleClues.clue: The final 8th letter is 'S'. Complete word is the guardian hound of Hades.

rounds.title: Round 3: Charon's Physical Trial
rounds.subtitle: An in-person physical challenge at the pub table. Complete it before the sands of time empty!

data.prompt: Stack 5 beer coasters / drink mats vertically on the pub table, or place all phones in a circle touching corners while singing a 10-second sea shanty to summon Charon!
rules: Every member of the crew must participate physically.
Once completed, show the bartender/Admin or enter the secret Pub Rune Code below.
Verification Code is announced live in the pub by the Game Master.
